episodes.description:
🚨 Ohio House of Horrors Update: Did Investigators Uncover a Cult in the Making?

The Ohio House of Horrors investigation continues to raise disturbing new questions about the Siders family, their isolated lifestyle, and the alleged control exercised over the children.

Was the Siders family creating their own cult? Was Elizabeth Siders manipulated or brainwashed? Were the grandparents the driving force behind an alleged system of control? 

In this episode, Matt Johnson is joined by renowned Forensic Psychotherapist Robi Ludwig, Psy.D., to analyze the latest evidence, discuss what investigators reportedly found inside the home, and explore the psychological and behavioral patterns that may help explain this shocking case.

Authorities allege that 16 Siders children were living in deplorable conditions and among the worst they had ever encountered.

Parents and Grandparents Gary Siders Jr., Elizabeth Siders, Gary Siders Sr., Christina Siders each face 16 felony counts of child endangerment. All defendants have pleaded Not Guilty.

🔍 #WhatDoYouThink about the Cult Theory?
